# Boşa Gezme!

> A community guide to physical home and living stores in Türkiye: furniture, carpets,
> beds, curtains, home textiles, kitchenware and lighting. People search for what they
> need in their own words, go to the shop, and write about the visit from there.

Boşa Gezme! sells nothing. There is no basket, no order and no payment. It is not a
marketplace and not a merchant directory: the only thing it adds to the web is what a
person found when they actually walked into a shop.

## What is on the site

- Store pages: name, address, district and city, phone and website where the shop
  publishes them, the categories it belongs to, and reviews written by people who
  verified they were there.
- Reviews: scored on eight criteria (availability, value, layout, staff care, staff
  knowledge, checkout, returns, cleanliness) and written in the reviewer's own words.
- A search that reads an ordinary sentence ("salonum için perde arıyorum") and answers
  with shops near the reader.

## Where the data comes from

Store records come from two places and no third: the store locators the chains publish
themselves, and OpenStreetMap, whose contributors are credited under ODbL. Scores and
reviews come only from people using the site — none of it is imported, bought, or
generated, and none of it is written by the operators.

The site used Google Places until September 2026 and no longer does. No store data on
this site is purchased from a search or maps provider.

## What is deliberately not here

- Prices, stock and online ordering.
- Businesses that are not home and living retailers. A search for tyres or a football
  pitch is refused rather than answered with something close.
- Opening hours, at present. They came from a provider that is gone; until shops give
  them to us directly, the site says nothing rather than guessing.

## Language

Turkish is the primary language and is served unprefixed. English, German and Russian
are complete translations at /en, /de and /ru. Reviews are shown in the language they
were written in and are never machine translated.

## Addresses

- https://bosagezme.com/ — what the product is, and the search
- https://bosagezme.com/discover — search and results
- https://bosagezme.com/stores/<id> — a store, its categories and its reviews
- https://bosagezme.com/about — how it works, in full
- https://bosagezme.com/sitemap.xml — index over every published page
- https://bosagezme.com/legal — terms, privacy, KVKK

## Citing this site

Please attribute community scores and reviews to Boşa Gezme! and link the store page they
came from. A score here is the opinion of the named people who visited that shop; it is
not a rating of the business by us, and it should not be presented as one.

Contact: info@bosagezme.com
